results.title: Rigathi Gachagua arrives in Embu ahead of DCP rally
results.description: Former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua has arrived in Embu County ahead of a major Democracy for the Citizens Party (DCP) rally scheduled for later on Saturday, July 25, 2026, as the party intensifies its grassroots mobilisation drive. Gachagua was received upon arrival by Manyatta Member of Parliament Gitonga Mukunji, alongside other local leaders and supporters [...]
